caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile object that appears to be a decorative banner or cloth with a patchwork design. It is composed of a central square featuring a brown horse with a black mane and tail, outfitted with a saddle and standing on green grass with rocks nearby. Surrounding the horse are bright red and beige squares. The top middle red square has the letters "W.S.S." written in stylized yellow and green script, while the bottom middle red square displays the letters "3 FOAL," also in a similar style. Each corner of the cloth has a beige square with an animal head: the upper left is an antlered deer, the upper right is a dog or wolf, the lower left is the head of a boar or a similar animal, and the lower right is another deer head with antlers. The two vertical side panels have a floral pattern with large red and pink flowers, green leaves, and smaller blue and purple details on a light background. The top and bottom borders feature fringes, with the majority colored red and the central part being a beige or off-white shade. The entire composition is set on a cream or off-white background.
title: Afghan
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
